name: Scrag Fighter 5

Scrag Fighter 5
CR 10

XP 9,600

Male Scrag Fighter 5

CE Large Humanoid (Aquatic, Giant)

Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft, low-light vision , scent , Perception + 5

DEFENSE

AC 18, 13 touch, 14 flat (+4 Dex, +5 natural, -1 size)
hp 136 (6d8+5d10+5 Favored Class +77); regeneration 5 (acid or fire)

OFFENSE

Melee +1 Vicious Adamantine Military Fork +16/+11 (2d4+14/x3 plus 2d6) and Bite +13 (1d6+7)

OR 2 Claws +19/+14 (1d6+12/19-20) and Bite +19 (1d6+12)

STATISTICS

Str 28, Dex 18, Con 24, Int 4, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +9; CMB +20 (+22 on bull rush); CMD 33 (35 vs. bull rush)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (Claw), Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (Bite), Weapon Focus (Claw), Weapon Specialization (Bite), Weapon Specialization (Claw)
Skills Perception +5, Swim +21
Languages Giant
SQ Amphibious
Gear +1 Vicious Adamantine Military Fork (Same statistics as a ranseur)
